title: Metal–organic framework-immobilized track-etched membrane with PVC nanofiber mats for carbon dioxide capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37348-37360
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04733A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aigerim Kh. Shakayeva, Dias D. Omertassov, Zhanna K. Zhatkanbayeva, Rafael I. Shakirzyanov, Ainash T. Zhumazhanova, Olgun Güven, Ilya V. Korolkov
Composite membranes combining PET track-etched membranes, PVC nanofibers, and HKUST-1 were developed, showing stable performance and regeneration ability, highlighting their potential as promising materials for sustainable CO2 capture.
